analysis.headline: USD/KRW plunges to 1,346.8 as post-midterm rally cools and exporters sell dollars
analysis.summary: USD/KRW dropped sharply to around 1,346.8 (ECB ref 1,346.79) as the post-U.S. midterm dollar surge lost steam and Treasury yields stabilized. A rebound in Wall Street tech shares coupled with intense exporter dollar selling (nego) above 1,350 and resilient semiconductor export flows spurred won appreciation, putting the pair into a 1,344–1,353 KRW range ahead of U.S. October CPI.

analysis.headline: EUR/KRW retreats to 1,507.5 as won gains outpace EUR/USD rebound
analysis.summary: EUR/KRW adjusted lower to around 1,507.5 (ECB ref 1,507.46). Lower crude oil prices (-4%) reduced European energy import burdens and global dollar softening lifted EUR/USD back near 1.1200. However, the Korean won staged a substantially stronger recovery in Seoul FX trading, pressing the cross lower within a 1,503–1,514 KRW range.

analysis.headline: JPY/KRW eases to 852.7 per 100 yen on intervention watch and won recovery
analysis.summary: JPY/KRW eased slightly to 8.53 KRW per yen (~852.7 KRW per 100 yen, ECB ref 8.527). USD/JPY traded around the high 157s, where Tokyo’s firm verbal intervention warnings and BOJ rate hike prospects capped downside pressure on the yen. However, stabilizing foreign flows in Seoul and broad KRW strength steered the cross within an 849–856 KRW band.

analysis.headline: GBP/KRW pulls back to 1,806.9 despite BoE 4.0% rate hike support
analysis.summary: GBP/KRW settled down toward 1,806.9 (ECB ref 1,806.86). The Bank of England’s monetary divergence following its benchmark rate hike to 4.0% and steady GBP/USD trading near 1.34 provided fundamental backing for sterling. Nevertheless, aggressive exporter dollar conversions in Seoul spurred a sharp won resurgence, keeping the pair contained within 1,800–1,814 KRW.

analysis.headline: CNY/KRW eases to 201.8 as PBOC liquidity supports amidst sharp USD/KRW pullback
analysis.summary: CNY/KRW softened toward 201.8 (ECB ref 201.83) within a 200.5–203.0 KRW band. While the PBOC ensured ample short-term liquidity injections and fixed a stable central parity rate alongside investor optimism over NPC Standing Committee fiscal stimulus, the broader slide in USD/KRW dragged the cross lower, anchoring trading between 201.0 and 202.5 KRW.

AUD.headline: AUD defends 928.5 KRW on hawkish RBA pause and commodity resilience
AUD.brief: The Australian dollar held ground near 928.5 KRW as RBA hawkishness and commodity stability offset broader USD softening, though won gains trimmed the cross.

CAD.headline: CAD slips to 955.0 KRW amid 4% oil slump and BoC easing differentials
CAD.brief: The Canadian dollar slid toward 955.0 KRW pressured by a 4% decline in global crude oil prices and monetary easing divergence from the Bank of Canada.

CHF.headline: CHF eases to 1,645.0 KRW as risk sentiment stabilizes and tech recovers
CHF.brief: The Swiss franc receded to 1,645.0 KRW as improved global market risk appetite and equity rebounds trimmed the currency’s safe-haven hedge premium.

CNY.headline: CNY stabilizes at 201.8 KRW backed by PBOC liquidity and stimulus hopes
CNY.brief: The Chinese yuan eased to 201.8 KRW alongside USD/KRW, though ample PBOC liquidity injections and fiscal stimulus expectations provided firm support.

EUR.headline: EUR softens to 1,507.5 KRW as Korean won outpaces EUR/USD rebound
EUR.brief: The euro settled at 1,507.5 KRW as a EUR/USD recovery toward 1.1200 on cheaper oil was overtaken by faster Korean won appreciation against the greenback.

GBP.headline: GBP holds 1,806.9 KRW supported by BoE 4.0% rate policy divergence
GBP.brief: The British pound consolidated near 1,806.9 KRW, maintaining policy divergence support from the BoE 4.0% rate hike despite broad won strength.

HKD.headline: HKD softens to 171.7 KRW tracking U.S. dollar pullback within peg band
HKD.brief: The Hong Kong dollar tracked the retreating U.S. dollar within its 7.75–7.85 peg band, easing to 171.7 KRW as Seoul currency markets rebounded.

JPY.headline: JPY steadies at 852.7 KRW per 100 yen on intervention alert and BOJ stance
JPY.brief: The Japanese yen settled near 852.7 KRW per 100 yen as Tokyo intervention vigilance limited losses while won appreciation capped cross gains.

KRW.headline: KRW surges to 1,346.8 on exporter dollar selling and tech exports
KRW.brief: The Korean won recovered sharply to 1,346.8 per USD, driven by post-midterm dollar moderation, heavy corporate exporter conversions, and strong AI chip exports.

USD.headline: USD drops to 1,346.8 KRW on yield easing and corporate exporter selling
USD.brief: The U.S. dollar tumbled to 1,346.8 KRW as post-election momentum waned, Treasury yields cooled, and corporate exporters offloaded dollars ahead of U.S. CPI.
